caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Ensure dough is soft and pliable before beginning to shape.
Apply even pressure with both hands to gradually round the dough into a smooth boule.
Keep work surface lightly dusted with flour to prevent sticking.
Continue shaping until the dough forms a uniform, round shape with a smooth surface.
